summary: The FULL frame-only maze solve is wired end-to-end: a single frame -> complete MazeModel (object/target/walls/checkpoints/hazards) -> maze planner -> executed -> the real env WINS, for tn36 L6 (checkpoint-multirun) AND L7 (timed-trap, first L7 solve). Zero internal state on the perception path.
pipeline: frame_to_maze_model (scripts/arc3_frame_induction.py) assembles arc_maze_planner.MazeModel from one frame -> checkpoint_multirun_plan / timed_trap_plan -> the leg-programs are executed in the real env.
frame_induced_fields: object start + target (hollow-outline sprite attrs), WALLS (the structural colour decomposed into ROW-RUNS so concave passages stay open), CHECKPOINTS (dithered object-colour pads), HAZARD band (marker colours) + the residual hidden hitboxes (band left/right edges).
offline_fields: move-codes (direction -> command code) + the invisible_slots cadence come from the offline program-editor transition model (atomic-run dynamics are not frame-inducible -- consistent across all findings).
key_fix: walls decomposed into ROW-RUNS not bounding boxes: the color-6 CC for L7's arch wall has a bbox that FILLS the interior passage at x[41,45) y[8,12) (open in the frame -> colours 4/11), which over-blocked the timed planner; row-runs preserve the gap and the timed plan is found. Also: induce_maze_sub_fields now excludes the target colour from hazard detection.
circularity_note: Frame-only perception + offline-model planning; the final plan is execution-grounded (env-confirmed). NOT a moat / oracle-distinct claim.
model_specs: frame-only perception (numpy/scipy.ndimage); arc_maze_planner; arc_program_editor_model codes; no LLM/GPU
closes: GAP-ARC-MAZE-MODEL-FRAME-INDUCTION end-to-end: the full live-generalization chain (DETECT -> ROUTE -> PERCEIVE -> PLAN -> env-confirmed SOLVE) now works frame-only for the program-editor MAZE class (L6 + L7), as it already did for the transform class (L1-L5).
